arxiv-2010-09932.title: Overlapping neural representations for the position of visible and imagined objects
arxiv-2010-09932.creator: Amanda K. Robinson, Tijl Grootswagers, Sophia M. Shatek, Jack Gerboni, Alex Holcombe, Thomas A. Carlson
arxiv-2010-09932.description: Abstract Humans can covertly track the position of an object, even if the object is temporarily occluded. What are the neural mechanisms underlying our capacity to track moving objects when there is no physical stimulus for the brain to track?

arxiv-2106-05194.title: DIGRAC: Digraph Clustering Based on Flow Imbalance
arxiv-2106-05194.creator: Yixuan He, Gesine Reinert, Mihai Cucuringu
arxiv-2106-05194.description: Abstract Node clustering is a powerful tool in the analysis of networks. We introduce a graph neural network framework, named DIGRAC, to obtain node embeddings for directed networks in a self-supervised manner, including a novel probabilistic imbalance loss, which can be used for network clustering.

arxiv-2203-11320.title: Valley engineering electron-hole liquids in TMDC monolayers
arxiv-2203-11320.creator: Arnab Barman Ray, Kevin Liang, Nick Vamivakas
arxiv-2203-11320.description: Abstract Electron-hole liquids(EHLs), a correlated state of matter and a thermodynamic liquid, have recently been found to exist at room temperature in suspended monolayers of MoS 2 \text{MoS}_{2} . Appreciably higher rates of radiative recombination inside the liquid as compared to free excitons hold promise for optoelectronic applications such as broadband lasing.

arxiv-2301-06918.title: Linear programming on the Stiefel manifold Thanks: Accepted by SIAM J. Optim.
arxiv-2301-06918.creator: Mengmeng Song, Yong Xia
arxiv-2301-06918.description: Abstract Linear programming on the Stiefel manifold (LPS) is studied for the first time. It aims at minimizing a linear objective function over the set of all p p -tuples of orthonormal vectors in ℝ n {\mathbb{R}}^{n} satisfying k k additional linear constraints. Despite the classical polynomial-time solvable case k = 0 k=0 , general (LPS) is NP-hard.

arxiv-2403-11872.title: NuGraph2: A Graph Neural Network for Neutrino Physics Event Reconstruction
arxiv-2403-11872.creator: A. Aurisano, V Hewes, G. Cerati, J. Kowalkowski, C. S. Lee, W. Liao, D. Grzenda, K. Gumpula, X. Zhang
arxiv-2403-11872.description: Abstract Liquid Argon Time Projection Chamber (LArTPC) detector technology offers a wealth of high-resolution information on particle interactions, and leveraging that information to its full potential requires sophisticated automated reconstruction techniques. This article describes NuGraph2 , a Graph Neural Network (GNN) for low-level reconstruction of simulated neutrino interactions in a LArTPC detector.

arxiv-2403-12701.title: Unraveling the dynamics of magnetization in topological insulator-ferromagnet heterostructures via spin-orbit torque
arxiv-2403-12701.creator: Taekoo Oh, Naoto Nagaosa
arxiv-2403-12701.description: Abstract Spin-orbit coupling stands as a pivotal determinant in the realm of condensed matter physics. In recent, its profound influence on spin dynamics opens up a captivating arena with promising applications. Notably, the topological insulator-ferromagnet heterostructure has been recognized for inducing spin dynamics through applied current, driven by spin-orbit torque.

arxiv-2501-09225.title: Provenance Guided Rollback Suggestions
arxiv-2501-09225.creator: DAVID ZHAO University of Sydney, PAVLE SUBOTIĆ Microsoft, MUKUND RAGHOTHAMAN University Southern California, BERNHARD SCHOLZ University of Sydney
arxiv-2501-09225.description: Abstract Advances in incremental Datalog evaluation strategies have made Datalog popular among use cases with constantly evolving inputs such as static analysis in continuous integration and deployment pipelines. As a result, new logic programming debugging techniques are needed to support these emerging use cases.

arxiv-2502-00409.title: Doing More with Less: A Survey on Routing Strategies for Resource Optimisation in Large Language Model-Based Systems
arxiv-2502-00409.creator: Clovis Varangot-Reille, Christophe Bouvard, Antoine Gourru, Mathieu Ciancone, Marion Schaeffer, François Jacquenet
arxiv-2502-00409.description: Abstract Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems, i.e. interconnected elements that include an LLM as a central component, such as conversational agents, are usually designed with monolithic, static architectures that rely on a single, general-purpose LLM to handle all user queries. However, these systems may be inefficient as different queries may require different levels of reasoning, domain knowledge or pre-processing.

arxiv-2503-20468.title: Determination of non-local characteristics of density transport in 2D simulations of the SOL
arxiv-2503-20468.creator: T. Gheorghiu 1,2, F. Militello 1, J. Juul Rasmussen 3
arxiv-2503-20468.description: Abstract By use of Lagrangian tracers propagated on 2D simulations of Scrape-Off Layer (SOL) turbulence, we are able to determine the non-local fractional-advection, fractional-diffusion equation (FADE) coefficients for a number of equilibrium cases. Solutions of the resultant FADEs shows good agreement with the simulated mean density profiles.

arxiv-2504-09677.title: Distinguishing the formation paths of massive compact ETGs through their internal dynamical structures
arxiv-2504-09677.creator: Ling Zhu 1, Ana L. Chies-Santos 2, Micheli Trindade Moura 2, Hanjing Shi 1
arxiv-2504-09677.description: Abstract Massive early-type galaxies (ETGs) are thought to form in two phases: an initial phase of rapid star formation and a later phase of mergers. A small fraction of these galaxies, called “red nuggets", formed during the first phase may have survived frozen to today, having experienced no massive mergers since z ∼ 2 z\sim 2 .

pmc-10524731.title: Comparative Analysis of Sampling Methods for Assessing Bacterial Contamination on Hospital Partition Curtains: Moistened Swabs versus RODAC Agar Plates
pmc-10524731.creator: Yaru Li, Leilei Li, Feng Chen, Dong Wang, Yaping Peng, Wanqiu Wang, Xiaxia Sun, Jianjun Deng, Juan Li
pmc-10524731.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundPartition curtains are one of the main sources of nosocomial infection in the hospital environment. However, there are no unified standards for monitoring medical textiles across different countries or regions. This study aimed to investigate the accuracy of 2 different sampling methods – swabbing vs RODAC (replicate organism detection and counting) agar plate – in terms of detection of bacterial contamination, and their suitability as monitoring methods for partition curtains and other medical textiles.Material/MethodsA total of 24 partition curtains were selected by

pmc-11385452.title: Titanite petrochronological data across the continental crust section exposed in Val d'Ossola (Ivrea-Verbano Zone, Italy)
pmc-11385452.creator: Stefania Corvò, Andrew RC Kylander-Clark, Antonio Langone
pmc-11385452.description: Titanite-bearing calc-silicates and mafic gneisses, metamorphosed under amphibolite- to granulite-facies conditions, crop out in Val d'Ossola area (Ivrea-Verbano Zone, Italy). The Ivrea-Verbano Zone represents an exhumed section of the pre-Alpine middle to lower continental crust which escaped the Alpine subduction, thus provides a unique opportunity to study continental crustal processes and evolution.

pmc-11543359.title: Herat’s Catastrophe: Earthquakes Deepen Afghanistan’s Healthcare Crisis
pmc-11543359.creator: Mirwais Ramozi, Hosain Barati, Yudai Kaneda, Akihiko Ozaki, Yasuhiro Kotera
pmc-11543359.description: In October 2023, Herat Province in Afghanistan was devastated by three earthquakes, resulting in 1,480 fatalities and 1,950 injuries, affecting approximately 154,000 people. The destruction included over 21,300 buildings, including 40 healthcare facilities, intensifying an existing humanitarian crisis under Taliban rule since August 2021.

pmc-12607498.title: Pediatric Bronchoscopy for the Adult Interventional Pulmonologist
pmc-12607498.creator: Alexa Rangecroft, Alfin Vicencio, Nidhi Kotwal, Siddhartha Dante, Ashutosh Sachdeva, Van Holden, George A Eapen
pmc-12607498.description: The field of pediatric bronchoscopy is rapidly expanding and enables diagnostic tests and therapeutic maneuvers, benefiting many children suffering from respiratory disease. However, due to a paucity of pediatric providers trained in bronchoscopy, many institutions rely on adult interventionalists collaborating with pediatric care teams to complete these procedures.

pmc-13052280.title: Mystery Disease X Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: A Narrative Review of Epidemiological Patterns and Response Challenges
pmc-13052280.creator: Muhammad Shaheer Bin Faheem, Muhammad Haroon‐Ul‐Rasheed, Sumaya Samadi
pmc-13052280.description: Background and AimsAn unknown disease known as Disease X first surfaced in the Panzi Health Zone, Kwango Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), towards the end of 2024. It mainly affected children under the age of five. The clinical characteristics and of the outbreak are examined in this review.

pmc-13188572.title: Performance of FTIR-Based IR Biotyper for Identification and Strain Discrimination of Cryptococcus Species
pmc-13188572.creator: Eun Jeong Won, Yukyung Jeon, Tae Yeul Kim, Yong-Sun Bahn, Heungsup Sung, Mi-Na Kim
pmc-13188572.description: The IR Biotyper is a commercialized real-time typing tool based on a Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy system. To date, it has not been evaluated for use with pathogenic Cryptococcus species complexes. This study aimed to assess the utility of the IR Biotyper for strain typing of pathogenic Cryptococcus species isolated from both environmental and clinical sources.

pmc-13336742.title: Junction Physics and Architectural Paradigms in Optoelectronic Semiconductor Fibers
pmc-13336742.creator: Hailiang Wang, Wenshu Ouyang, Yuhang Xiao, Wei Yan, Meifang Zhu
pmc-13336742.description: Optoelectronic fibers are emerging as a foundational platform for distributed sensing, energy harvesting, optical communication in wearable electronics, soft robotics, and embodied intelligence. Unlike planar optoelectronic devices, fibers must intrinsically integrate light emission, detection, and modulation within scalable, deformable textile networks.

pmc-13657744.title: Development and internal validation of a machine learning prediction model for postoperative hemorrhage following modified radical mastectomy for breast cancer
pmc-13657744.creator: Weiyuan Chen, Xiaoxu Li, Xiaoman Zhang, Wenqi Shen
pmc-13657744.description: BackgroundPostoperative hemorrhage is a clinically meaningful complication of modified radical mastectomy (MRM), but existing risk-prediction models rely on logistic regression (LR), rarely provide interpretable individualized risk attribution, and have not been specifically developed or internally validated for MRM. We aimed to develop and internally validate machine learning models for predicting clinically significant postoperative hemorrhage after MRM.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any officer or employee, while detailed or assigned under this part, shall be considered, for the purpose of preserving their allowances, privileges, rights, seniority, and other benefits as such, an officer or employee.
